about: Nityas Gems and Jewellery Limited is an India-based jewellery company engaged in the design, manufacturing, and sale of lab-grown diamond studded gold jewellery. It operates an integrated model comprising B2B wholesale supply to retail chains and standalone jewellers across 18 states and 2 union territories, alongside omnichannel D2C retail through its subsidiary Ayaani. Its primary manufacturing facility is located in Surat, Gujarat, with an installed capacity of 360 kg per annum.

objects.purpose: Funding Working Capital requirements of our Company

promoters.background: Promoters collectively possess over 29 years of experience in the gems and jewellery industry, led by Managing Director Rajnikant Lallubhai Chanchad who has over 20 years of experience.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers contributed 55.49%, 76.68%, and 84.24% of revenue from operations in FY26, FY25, and FY24 respectively.

strengths: Integrated business model combining B2B manufacturing and distribution with omnichannel D2C retail operations through subsidiary Ayaani.
Expanding customer base with B2B clients increasing from 74 in FY24 to 323 in FY26 across 18 states and 2 union territories.
Robust in-house design capabilities with a portfolio exceeding 32,000 designs supported by CAD/CAM and 122 skilled karigars.
Well-positioned to benefit from rapid domestic and global growth in the affordable lab-grown diamond jewellery market.
Strong financial performance with revenue expanding at 94.46% CAGR from FY24 to FY26 alongside expanding EBITDA margins of 15.27%.

risks.title: Customer Concentration Risk
risks.detail: Top 10 customers accounted for 55.49%, 76.68%, and 84.24% of revenue in FY26, FY25, and FY24 respectively; loss of key clients could severely harm business.

risks.title: Negative Operating Cash Flows
risks.detail: Reported negative cash flows from operations of ₹14.73 crore in FY26, ₹10.05 crore in FY25, and ₹1.05 crore in FY24 due to rising working capital.

risks.title: Increasing Working Capital Requirements
risks.detail: Working capital requirements surged from ₹6.77 crore in FY24 to ₹44.95 crore in FY26; failure to manage capital needs may adversely impact operations.

risks.title: Supplier Concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 suppliers contributed 86.16%, 94.31%, and 87.05% of raw material purchases in FY26, FY25, and FY24 respectively.

risks.title: Geographic Concentration of Revenue
risks.detail: Five states (Gujarat, Karnataka, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, and Maharashtra) accounted for 85.03% of total revenues in FY26 and 92.71% in FY25.

risks.title: Single Manufacturing Facility Concentration
risks.detail: All manufacturing operations are concentrated at a single 7,000 sq. ft facility in Surat, Gujarat, exposing the company to local disruption risks.

notes: Financial figures converted from INR millions to INR crores. Fiscal 2026 includes operations of subsidiary Ayaani acquired in July 2025.
